correctness.rationale: The cyclic equations give the exact primitive weights and degree. The determinant is \(\prod_{i=0}^{5}b_i-1=17279\); the weight sum is \(\sum_i a_i=17265\); pairwise coprimality gives a well-formed ambient space, and the witness hypersurface meets its singular locus only in finitely many coordinate points, so it is well-formed. The derivative argument proves quasismoothness and irreducibility. Esser's Theorem 3.2 applies to prove rationality, and adjunction gives the ample Q-Cartier class \(K_X\sim_{\mathbb Q}14H\). The exhaustive script checks the finite minimality bound and the explicit noncanonical age \(2301/2315\).

originality.rationale: The determinant criterion and rationality of this witness are covered by prior work. The distinct claim is the exact minimum degree within the stated six-variable loop/determinant class. targeted indexed searches for exact weights, aliases, broader weighted-hypersurface coverage, and a matching minimum/table returned only non-equivalent nearby results. The finite search is bounded by the witness product and checks every exponent multiset/order in that bound.
residual_risks: A published but unindexed table of loop polynomials could contain the same extremal minimum; the searches do not prove absolute novelty.
The minimum is restricted to single six-variable loop polynomials with exponents at least two, primitive well-formed weights, and the determinant rationality criterion.
The self-review and exhaustive script are not an independent audit or independent validation.
